note: Public, non-secret settings for the live stats (read by /api and, from Phase 6, by the page). refreshMinutes: how old the cached snapshot may get before /api/stats fetches again (15 to 1440). showPlatforms: which platforms the page shows, in order. platforms.*.enabled: false stops the server from calling that platform at all. platforms.*.documented: a total you can prove with a screenshot; the site shows max(live, documented) per platform, so it never double counts. facebook stays disabled until you confirm facebook.com/eroedtx is a Page (see docs/SOCIAL-API-SETUP.md step 9). Never put keys or tokens in this file: it is public.
